objective: Decide whether Juno should allocate a bounded budget to UK expansion.

context_sources.summary: A bounded UK expansion budget is under consideration.
context_sources.relevance_to_decision: Defines the capital-allocation choice and geographic option.

cognitive_needs.why_selected: Expansion options have different probabilities and payoffs.
cognitive_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Probability-weighted value of committing versus waiting.

cognitive_needs.why_selected: Demand, regulation, and execution can form materially different futures.
cognitive_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the choice is robust across plausible UK futures.

cognitive_needs.why_selected: Demand, CAC, and delivery cost estimates may cross the decision threshold.
cognitive_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Which input ranges reverse the investment recommendation.

cognitive_needs.why_selected: The same budget and founder attention have other uses.
cognitive_needs.uncertainty_reduced: The value of the best foregone Juno investment.

domain_needs.why_selected: The decision exposes cash and requires affordability and capital-allocation standards.
domain_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Whether downside is affordable and returns are financially coherent.

domain_needs.why_selected: Expansion must fit where Juno can win and what it will not fund instead.
domain_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Whether UK expansion is strategically coherent.

quality_needs.why_selected: Expansion failure modes should be identified before capital is committed.
quality_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Plausible failure causes, indicators, and stop conditions.

quality_needs.why_selected: Market and financial inputs are incomplete.
quality_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Which investment inputs are facts, estimates, or unknowns.

epistemic_register.statement: The budget and evidence-backed return range are not yet established.

uncertainty_register: Demand, CAC, delivery cost, budget, and opportunity cost remain uncertain.
